Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the supply, storage and distribution of goods produced by the company.

Negotiate contracts with suppliers to meet quality, cost and delivery requirements

Liaise with other departments and customers concerning requirements for outward goods and associated forwarding transportation

Responding to any issues or complaints.

Ensure all operations adhere to laws, guidelines, and ISO requirements.

Minimum associate degree in business administration, logistics, supply chain, or relevant field, preferably bachelor’s degree
Minimum 1-3 years of experience in a similar role
In-depth knowledge of the consumer goods industry.

Essential Skills
Attention to detail
Ability to multitask efficiently
Knowledge of logistics software
Great communication skills, verbal and written
Critical thinking abilities
Problem solving skills
Organisational abilities
